profile.subtitleJa: コハテ族の町に関する記述で、エフライム族の名が現れます。
profile.summaryJa: 歴代誌上6:66は、コハテ族の一部の町がエフライム族の領域内にあったと述べています。

facts.textJa: 歴代誌上6:67は、エフライムの山地にシェケムがあると記します。
歴代誌上9:3は、エルサレムに住む人々の中にエフライムとマナセの子らを挙げます。
歴代誌上12:30は、エフライムの子らの中からダビデのもとへ来た勇士の数を記します。
歴代誌上27:10、14、20は、エフライムの子らに属する軍務の指揮官や役人を列挙します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.
They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,
In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:
Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.
The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah;

wikipediaCheck.locator: Tribe of Ephraim article, lead lines 138–145 says the tribe is one of the Twelve Tribes; lines 144 and 177–178 discuss the named ancestor Ephraim and 1 Chronicles 7:20–24.

review.remainingUncertaintyJa: 7:20/22の父祖個人用法は本文で明確だが、部族用法と同一カードへまとめず個人-context variantとして別レビューを要する。
